description: Use this when someone asks when a member is booked, which sessions a trainer has, or what is booked on a day, including to move or cancel one. Returns sessions across all the user's gyms or one, with id, member, gym and trainer ids, times, status and edit time for any date window, latest first, up to 100. Not for counting how busy each day is.

endTime.description: Only sessions ending before this ISO 8601 time

gymId.description: Only sessions at this gym, by an id from the user's gym list; every gym when absent

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return (default 20, maximum 100)

memberId.description: Only sessions of this member, by an id from list_members

startTime.description: Only sessions starting at or after this ISO 8601 time

name: list_appointments

appointments.description: Sessions, latest start first. Notes, services, reminders, contact details, organization data and payment details are excluded.

lastEditTime.description: Version to pass as expectedLastEditTime when moving or cancelling it

providerIds.description: Trainers booked on it, as list_trainers ids

title: List gym sessions
